portal_hypertension.title: A Review of Terlipressin in Hepatorenal Syndrome: Targeting Endothelial Dysfunction and Subsequent Cardiovascular Adverse Events.
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：最终，内脏血管舒张和肠道淋巴液产生过多导致腹水、有效动脉血容量低以及适应不良的代偿机制，从而导致肾脏灌注不足和损伤。 临床提示：肝肾综合征（HRS）是失代偿性肝硬化的严重并发症，可导致急性肾损伤（AKI）。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Hepatorenal syndrome (HRS) is a serious complication of decompensated liver cirrhosis that results in acute kidney injury (AKI). The mortality rate is high. Endothelial dysfunction secondary to liver cirrhosis is a key driver of the development of portal hypertension, which is eventually complicated by ascites and HRS. Ultimately, splanchnic vasodilation and excess gut lymph production result in ascites, low effective arterial blood volume, and maladaptive compensatory mechanisms that contribute to renal hypoperfusion and injury.
